question: we've moved the business to London so want deals showing in pounds now. how do i do that

articles.title: Change your currency
articles.body:
1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose a **Currency**: **AUD**, **NZD**, **USD**, **GBP** or **EUR**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

Changing the currency changes the symbol shown on every deal. It doesn't convert existing values.

answer:
Change your currency in your client profile:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Choose **GBP** in **Currency**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

This changes the symbol shown on every deal, but it doesn't convert existing values.
